item.title: Katie Zacharia Offered White House Press Secretary Role
item.description: A White House official confirmed that Katie Zacharia has been offered the position of White House Press Secretary.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias Strengthens to Category 3, Threatens Northern Gulf Coast
item.description: Hurricane Isaias, the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026, is moving toward the northern Gulf Coast and is expected to make landfall on Friday.

item.title: First Banana Bowl set to bring a playful twist to baseball
item.description: Banana Ball creator Jesse Cole and Savannah Bananas players Jackson Olson and Frankie Moscatiello, along with Texas Tailgater Jonathan Luders, preview the event.

item.title: Top Democrats align with wealthy interests against California billionaire tax proposal
item.description: A first-of-its-kind California plan to tax billionaires may reveal voter attitudes toward wealth taxes on the ultra-rich.
